svg.title: L uses pitch freedom to seat before locking the same pad for the ramp; roll remains outside that freedom.
svg.desc: Three side views of the same compression fixture show a rigid pad, circular transverse pin, coupon and fixed platen. E is locked horizontal with an illustrative edge contact. F and L lie parallel to the pitch slope, but only F remains free in the ramp. L seats at 10 N, holds and acknowledges preload, locks without lifting, then zeros and ramps 0.20 mm. A roll slope cannot be corrected.

text.tspan: DEMO | Same fixture in three states | Side view; slopes exaggerated
